data.name: Senders - Wide Open Dirtbike Sim
data.detailed_description:
Senders is a Dirtbike Simulator taking place over a 20km squared plot of roads, tracks, trails and wilderness. Built from the ground up to provide the deepest, dirtiest riding experience available.

  • Uncompromising Full Physics Sim - Soft tires, suspension, leg muscles and tuned aerodynamics, with the ability to tune setup on the fly to take on any terrain and weather

  • Full Rider Control - Lean forward, shift your seating, stand in the bumps and sit in the corners, every motion is simulated and under your control

  • Controlled Chaos - Handlebars automatically counter steer and aim into slides, rider's feet automatically dab down to save the bike from drops and help crawl over difficult terrain

  • Terrain Deformation - Your tires instantly cut deep ruts into dirt and gravel, leaving your mark on the ground and affecting your handling at speed

  • Per-branch Foliage Deformation - Every twig on trees, bushes and even grass will put up a fight against your tires, handlebars and rider, making woods riding an authentic challenge

  • Real Graphics for Real Physics - Custom game engine with modern high performance CPU mesh processing ensures that the visual effects on-display are real geometry that affects your riding, not just a shader

  • Dynamic Weather - Hard-packed trails in dry weather behave differently to rain-soaked ruts

Senders provides an open sandbox for players to explore alone or in groups, with simple challenges and events - Campaign/story mode, AI, leaderboards, first-party tournaments, real-world tracks, and VR support will NOT be available at launch.

Support for custom tracks and bikes will be available for the full launch.
